about_short_description.short_description: VôM is a homegrown accounting software platform.

product.name: VôM Cloud Accounting Software
product.description: A cloud-based accounting platform for issuing electronic invoices, managing sales, purchases, expenses, and generating financial reports compliant with Saudi tax authorities.

product.name: VôM Electronic Invoicing
product.description: A feature within VôM for generating tax-compliant electronic invoices with QR codes, aligned with Saudi Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority requirements.

product.name: VôM Financial Reporting
product.description: Provides multiple accurate and real-time financial reports to support business decision-making and regulatory compliance.

product.name: VôM System Integration
product.description: Integration capabilities that allow VôM to synchronize sales, purchases, and accounting data automatically with other business systems.

product.name: VôM Mobile Application
product.description: An iOS application that allows users to access and manage their accounting records and financial data remotely.
